targets.rawSql: SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.credential_stuffing_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.session_hijacking_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.report_anomaly_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_type='Guest' AND login_status!='LOGIN_NO_ERROR'
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.api_anomaly_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_date)
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_type='Guest'
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.apex_execution_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND quiddity = 'X'
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.login_events l JOIN salesforceProd.users u ON l.user_id=u.id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.timestamp) AND u.is_active=0 AND l.login_status='LOGIN_NO_ERROR'
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.package_install_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.insufficient_access_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count() as n FROM salesforceProd.permission_update_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, count() as calls FROM (SELECT timestamp FROM salesforceProd.rest_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT timestamp FROM salesforceProd.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, count() as exports FROM salesforceProd.report_export_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, count() as views FROM salesforceProd.uri_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, countIf(login_status='LOGIN_NO_ERROR') as logins FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, count() as failed FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND login_status!='LOGIN_NO_ERROR' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, count() as login_as FROM salesforceProd.login_as_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT browser_type as browser, count() as logins FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND browser_type!='' GROUP BY browser ORDER BY logins DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT client_ip, count() as logins, count(DISTINCT login_key) as unique_sessions FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND client_ip!='' GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY logins DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, countIf(login_status='LOGIN_NO_ERROR') as successful, countIf(login_status!='LOGIN_NO_ERROR') as failed FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT if(api_type='','Browser/UI',api_type) as api_type, count() as logins FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY api_type ORDER BY logins DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT timestamp, dictGetOrDefault('salesforceProd.user_lookup', 'username', user_id, user_name) AS username, user_id as user_identifier, login_status, browser_type, client_ip, login_type FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${full_name}'='All' OR user_name='${full_name}') AND ('${user_id}'='All' OR user_id='${user_id}') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT dictGetOrDefault('salesforceProd.user_lookup', 'username', delegated_user_id, delegated_user_name) AS impersonated_user, dictGetOrDefault('salesforceProd.user_lookup', 'username', user_id, user_name) AS impersonated_by, count() as times, max(timestamp) as last_seen FROM salesforceProd.login_as_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY delegated_user_name, user_name ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, count() as impersonations FROM salesforceProd.login_as_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT extract(uri,'/lightning/o/([^/?#]+)') as object_type, count() as accesses FROM salesforceProd.uri_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND match(uri,'/lightning/o/') AND extract(uri,'/lightning/o/([^/?#]+)')!='' GROUP BY object_type ORDER BY accesses DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT uri, count() as hits FROM salesforceProd.uri_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY uri ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT extract(uri,'/lightning/r/([^/]+)/') as record_type, count() as accesses FROM salesforceProd.uri_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND match(uri,'/lightning/r/') AND extract(uri,'/lightning/r/([^/]+)/')!='' GROUP BY record_type ORDER BY accesses DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT uri as resource, method, 'REST' as api_type, user_agent as client_name, count() as row_count
FROM salesforceProd.rest_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY resource, method, client_name
UNION ALL
SELECT entity_name as resource, method_name as method, 'SOAP' as api_type, '' as client_name, count() as row_count
FROM salesforceProd.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY resource, method, client_name
ORDER BY row_count DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT user_agent as client_name, count() as calls FROM salesforceProd.rest_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_agent!='' GROUP BY client_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, 'REST' as api_type, count() as calls
FROM salesforceProd.rest_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY t, api_type
UNION ALL
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) as t, 'SOAP' as api_type, count() as calls
FROM salesforceProd.api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY t, api_type
ORDER BY t

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT user_name FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE user_name != '' ORDER BY user_name LIMIT 500
list.label: Full Name
list.name: full_name
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT username FROM salesforceProd.users WHERE username != '' AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY username LIMIT 500

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE ('${full_name}'='All' OR user_name='${full_name}') AND user_id!='' LIMIT 500
list.label: User ID
list.name: user_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE ('${full_name}'='All' OR user_name='${full_name}') AND user_id!='' LIMIT 500
